scope_notes: Raw inventory includes known queued identities without fresh complete market snapshots; observations can repeat across cycles.
Fixed 30-pool sample is the nonrandom archived v5.2 sample; all 30 identities were reobserved on every run. Temporal changes are not causal A/B evidence.
RPC lead counts do not imply market/safety verification. Only Raydium CPMM initialize is decoded.
Partial-improvement counts can repeat; they are not unique fully recovered tokens.
Provider ledgers are conservative application estimates and do not read account billing or other applications.
